Roots also include observed CPU addresses replicated into byte-identical copies (shared 16 KiB engine of 32K banks 4-7) and opcode-aligned copies of the common $8000-$8353 module in every bank; edges leaving those module copies are not followed unless observed (banks 4-7 copies contain unresolved JSR $FFFF placeholders, i.e. dead copies). Not executed in recorded scenarios.
